{{Attr|Burn}} (Variable) }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Korblox Warrior''' was an enemy that appeared in [[The Classic Event]]. It had a high amount of health but it was quite slow. ==Appearance== The '''Korblox Warrior''' had blue skin and a neon blue head. It wore a blue helmet with horns, shoulder-pads and chestplate, and grey arm-pads. The front of the chestplate was shaped like a face, with neon blue eyes and teeth, a white nose and eyebrows. It also had grey shoes, black pants and shirt. ==Strategy== *Early on, towers like the [[Militant]], [[Golden Soldier]] or [[Golden Scout]] can be good options against the '''Korblox Warrior'''. *High DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]], [[Engineer]] or [[Accelerator]] are very effective against the '''Korblox Warrior'''. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} KorbloxWarriorSlowStomp.gif|Walking animation (23 May 2024 – 12 March 2025) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnail}} TheClassicUpdateThumbnail.png|'''Korblox Warrior''' on a thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} TDSClassicMiniEventPromo.png|'''Korblox Warrior''' on a promotional image. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Korblox Warrior''' is based on the [https://www.roblox.com/bundles/256/Korblox-General Korblox General] package. ==Update History== *'''23 May 2024''' - [[v1.23.0]] **'''Korblox Warrior''' added. *'''28 May 2024''' - [[v1.23.0|v1.23.3]] **'''Korblox Warrior''' removed. *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **'''Korblox Warrior''' re-added. *'''12 March 2025''' - [[v1.57.0]] **'''Korblox Warrior''' removed. {{ClassicWinter|[[Korblox Soul (The Classic)|Korblox Soul]]|Wave 3|Korblox Warrior|Wave 4|[[Breaker2]] & [[Redcliff Traitor (The Classic)|Redcliff Traitor]]|Wave 7}} {{ClassicIslandChaos|[[Korblox Undead (The Classic)|Korblox Undead]]|Wave 2|Korblox Warrior|Wave 4|[[Korblox Soul (The Classic)|Korblox Soul]]|Wave 5}} {{ClassicCastle|[[Korblox Seeker (The Classic)|Korblox Seeker]] & [[Breaker2]]|Wave 4|[[Korblox Soul (The Classic)|Korblox Soul]] & Korblox Warrior|Wave 5|[[Hidden Boss]]|Wave 6}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Korblox Warrior}}
